modelGuidance:
Luna is the lowest-cost, fastest model in this workflow. Use it for token-intensive work that primarily involves gathering, filtering, or organizing evidence, including browser interaction, web research, session-history retrieval, broad inventories, and extracting facts from many files or records. Luna should report evidence, source locations, and coverage gaps rather than make consequential technical decisions from incomplete evidence. It is the only model allowed to use browser tools. When browser work requires engineering judgment, Sol or Fable should direct the investigation and interpret Luna's results.

Sol is the balanced general-purpose model and the normal starting point for straightforward engineering work. Use it when the task primarily involves understanding code, applying established repository patterns, routine implementation, or synthesizing evidence. Prefer Sol when the intended approach is clear and existing patterns adequately address the problem. If Sol discovers that existing patterns do not adequately cover the problem, it should hand the task to Fable with its findings rather than improvise a new design.

Fable is the preferred model whenever planning, architecture design, implementation, or code writing requires more than applying an established pattern. Use it when no suitable pattern exists, existing patterns are insufficient, requirements are ambiguous or conflicting, or meaningful design tradeoffs must be resolved. Task size alone is not the deciding factor: large but mechanical work may remain with Sol, while small but novel work may warrant Fable.

Astra is available as an independent perspective for reviewing and verifying complex work. Consider it after a substantive plan or implementation exists when challenging assumptions, assessing architectural or behavioral risks, or independently verifying consequential work would provide meaningful value. Work being produced by Fable may make cross-model review useful, but is not by itself a reason to select Astra. Do not use Astra or pair models merely to increase agent count.
